name: Genesis
moduleSystem: classic-scripts (shared global scope) — ES modules deferred until inline onclick handlers are rebound

modules.desc: The single mutable-state container (GS). All transient app/creator state (CGEN/BARDO/CG_DRAG/FATE_CTX/SEED/ORC) lives here as GS.* — greppable, one home. `var` so GS is on window (inline on* handlers need it). U stays in world.state. Established 2026-06-20 per docs/SCALING.md.
Pronoun sets for character creation + DM narration. Player picks a set; stored on the soul/character; surfaced to the DM in the handoff. pronounSet(id) expands to subj/obj/poss/reflex.

The SCRIPT for the guided Genesis ritual (carved out of genesis.html 2026-06-22): the ordered world-genesis beats (STAGES, aliased WORLDBEATS), the spirit-guide narration (GUIDE), and the Life-chain step metadata (LIFE_STEP). Plain data read at call-time by world.play (world beats) + creator.* (the guided new-game passage).

The standard-actions reference vocabulary for the in-session Actions panel (docs/IN-SESSION-UI.md §5b) — name + one-line plain-English description per SRD standard action (Attack/Dash/Disengage/Dodge/Help/Hide/Ready/Search/Study/Influence/Utilize/Grapple/Shove). Rendered as non-interactive reference cards (inform-only, no onclick) so the player reads them and types their action rather than clicking a command button. Hand-authored; small + stable, no generator.
XGE biography tables + bg/class why-prose.
Per-species name pools.

The 12 regional name-culture banks (REGIONS-NAMES.md §3/§5) — female/male/family pools per culture, generated by build/gen-names.py --cultures from Name Cultures.md. Not yet wired to a consumer (on-demand-gen's region-culture NPC mint is a later batch-2 unit).
World/setting tables (T) + the player-facing Fragment oracle veil (FRAG), row-aligned to T.
Starting-state tables: factions/pressures/the uncanny/entry (SS), concretization map (SS_CONC), opening-bundle fallbacks (EB).
Layer-1 mechanical char data (abilities, classes, species, backgrounds) + guided-Sheet tooltips (TIP).

Curated SRD 5.2.1/2024-PHB class data the guided creator walks: skill choices (n-from-list), starting-equipment packages (A/B/gold), and L1 spellcasting (cantrip/spell counts + list + ability). Plus faction-proximity affinity (METHOD_KIND maps a faction's Method→kind; CLASS_FACTION_AFFINITY tilts which local power a class is born near — docs/DEATH-AND-REBIRTH.md step 4). Transcribed+verified from Reference/SRD-Data/classes.md. Added 2026-06-21.

Cantrip + level-1 spell picker surface (name/level/school/classes/flavor). GENERATED by build/gen-spells-slim.py from Reference/SRD-Data/spells.json — never hand-edit. file:// loads it as a <script> global. Added 2026-06-21.

The FULL 339-spell index (docs/SRD-MECHANIZATION.md §2, Decision 1: FULL) — every spell at every level with name/level/school/classes + castingTime/range/components/duration + ritual/concentration + atHigherLevels + a parsed save{ability}/attack shape + flavor/text. GENERATED by build/gen-spells.py from Reference/SRD-Data/spells.json — never hand-edit. Concentration enforcement (engine.concentration) + the DM's mid-scene lookups read this; data/spells-slim.js stays the creator's cantrip+L1 filtered view onto it. SPELLS_BY_NAME is the normalized-name lookup (itemKey-style fold). Added 2026-07-01.

Levels 1-20 advancement for all 12 base classes: proficiency bonus, features (full SRD text embedded), spell slots / cantrips / prepared counts (full/half/pact), and class resource scalers (rage, sneak attack, sorcery points, etc.). The load-bearing data for leveling (docs/ADVANCEMENT.md). GENERATED by build/gen-class-progression.py from Reference/SRD-Data/classes.md — never hand-edit; the parser validates parsed spell-slot grids against canonical matrices. L1 reconciles with data/srd-creator.js. Added 2026-06-21.

GENERATED (build/gen-subclass-progression.py) from the SRD markdown: each base class's single SRD subclass — name, intro, and per-level features (full text). The level-up picker reveals these at L3 (grant) / L6 / L10 / …. Never hand-edit; regenerate. See docs/ADVANCEMENT.md.

Original IP-clean GENERAL FEATS (the SRD ships almost none) offered at an ASI level instead of a +2 bump. Full feats = a standalone benefit; half feats = +1 to a listed ability + a modest benefit. The engine applies the mechanical grant (ability/HP/AC/speed/save/skill) + records the feat; situational text is DM-adjudicated. See docs/ADVANCEMENT.md.

GENERATED (build/gen-bestiary.py) from Asset Library/Monsters & Enemies/*.md — the runtime monster stat index the combat resolver (src/engine/combat.js) + the threat→stat-block resolver read (docs/COMBAT.md, Layer 1). One entry per stat block (510 from 374 files); AC/HP/CR/abilities at 100%, attacks ~99%. Adam's hand-authored custom d-tables are carried VERBATIM as customTables and never mechanized (the engine surfaces them to the DM). BESTIARY_BY_CR indexes ids by CR for the threat-resolver fallback. Never hand-edit; regenerate. Added 2026-06-30.

GENERATED (build/gen-items.py) from Reference/SRD-Data/equipment-weapons-armor.json (weapons+armor, structured JSON) + equipment.md's real Adventuring Gear + Ammunition tables (regex-parsed) + magic-items.json — the type/instance split for gear (docs/ITEMS.md, the bestiary pattern reapplied). ITEMS_BY_NAME holds objective per-name facts (damage dice+type, AC spec, weight, cost, properties, mastery) that sheet.inventory instances resolve at read time; never mutates at runtime. MAGIC_ITEMS_BY_NAME (docs/ITEMS.md §E, congruence) is the magic reference catalog (rarity/attunement/type/description) + parsed enchantment overlay (bonus/damageRider/acBonus/charges) + potion consumable effects (healing tiers numeric; other potions structured buffs) — a magic instance resolves BASE mechanics off ITEMS_BY_NAME via inst.base and carries per-copy magic in inst.ench. ITEM_CONDITIONS is the fixed per-instance status vocabulary (on-fire/poisoned-coated/cursed/broken/dropped/rusted; frozen/waterlogged cut 2026-07-01). PACK_EXPANSIONS resolves each of the 7 SRD starting-equipment packs to its real individual line items (replacing the old bundled-string PACK_CONTENTS model — every pack item is its own thing). Unindexed names degrade gracefully (flavor-only, never dropped). Never hand-edit; regenerate. Added 2026-06-30.

Economy v1 (docs/ECONOMY.md) — hand-authored (NOT generated) balance data for the buy/sell engine (src/engine/economy.js). RARITY_VALUE is the authored magic-item price band (Common 100 / Uncommon 400 / Rare 4000 / Very Rare 40000 / Legendary 200000 / Artifact priceless) — IP-clean, genericized structure with Adam's own numbers, no source table pasted. SELL_RATIO (0.5) is the SRD half-value sell baseline. PLACE_TIERS gates shop stock rarity + size + merchant coin by PLACE tier (hamlet/village/town/city), never by PC level — Very Rare+ is never listed in any tier (T1/T2 scope, structural not probabilistic). SHOP_ARCHETYPES (general/apothecary/smith/arcanist) gates which item categories/magic kinds each shop type stocks. HEALING_POTION_NAME + APOTHECARY_HEALING_GUARANTEE back the keystone-sink reliability rule (an apothecary always stocks a healing consumable). All numbers here are provisional balance knobs — the one file to tune after playtest. Added 2026-07-01.

Canon Wandering Souls — Adam's hand-made characters that ship as source and are seeded into every roster (world.state.seedCanonSouls). End-users' banked souls stay local; the roster is the union. Replaces the old one-off ROBIN_SEED.
Dice, table lookup, id, pick.
Table-roll primitives: rollTbl (flat/bell + mod), fragAt (FRAG veil), ebRoll (opening-bundle), concretize (uncanny roll-chain).

Starting-state roll-chains: faction/pressure rollers, the Entry bridge (entrySeeds/pickTension/rollEntry incl. faction proximity via factionKind/rollFactionProximity), and the ssFactionTurn web-tick. Writes to the world ledger at call-time.
Lazy deterministic hex substrate (docs/SPATIAL-MODEL.md): hash-terrain + axial geometry + node placement. renderHexMap (the SVG paint) stays in the app until the world/render carve.

The live consumable resource economy (docs/EVENT-CONTRACT.md + docs/ADVANCEMENT.md): derives current-vs-max HP / spell slots / pact slots / class pools (Rage, Bardic Inspiration, Channel Divinity, Focus, Sorcery Points, Action Surge) from CLASS_PROGRESSION, lazily inits current=max on the sheet, and owns every mutator (applyHpDelta/spendSlot/spendResource/restRecover) the DM events dispatch to. resourceDigest feeds dmDigest.

The XP economy + leveling spine (docs/ADVANCEMENT.md, docs/TIER-SCOPE.md, docs/ADVANCEMENT-RETUNE.md). XP accrues on the living sheet (awardXp) priced from resolved-tension events (xpForEvent); levelForXp clamps to LEVEL_CEILING=10 (the Tier-2 cap's primary enforcement); applyLevelUp re-derives + GROWS HP/proficiency/spell slots/class pools from CLASS_PROGRESSION on a rest (ensureResources only fills missing, so growth is explicit). XP_THRESHOLDS = SRD 5.2.1 canon (full L1–20; ceiling enforced in code). ADVANCEMENT-RETUNE.md's spine flip lives in XP_TUNE (one named-constant block, provisional until §4 telemetry): encounter_resolved is UN-GATED with a per-session (crBand,node) decay guard (decayMultiplier/crBandOf/decayKey) + an objective ×bonus (was a gate); front_closed/clock_fired(-survived) re-price off encounterUnit (E(L), derived from CR_XP — a function, not a table copy); encounterResolvedXp exposes {paid,full,lost} for the §4 xpReport instrument. Interpretive picks (spells/ASI/subclass) are DM-narrated in v1.

Persistence + the World Spine: localStorage universe (loadU/saveU), in-world clock, the World State Ledger (append-only), the node-graph map, and additive legacy-save migration. The live mutable global U stays app-owned (transient state like SEED/ORC lives in GS); these read/write U at call-time.

The relational entity store (docs/CODEX.md): NPC/Location/Item/Faction records with rolled (verbatim) + fields (player-safe) + dm (DM-only) + typed links[] (wikilinks) + status{known,soft,at,condition}. Two-tier lifecycle: SOFT entities are a recontextualizable pool (codexRecontextualize preserves the rolled soul, reassigns context); the player TOUCHING one locks it to canon forever (codexContact; recontextualize refuses on hard records). codexDigest = all-seeing DM slice; codexPlayerView = knowledge-gated sanitized projection. Written only via codex_* events in world.dm; ensureCodex migrates gazetteer/factions in (idempotent, non-destructive). Phase 1 of CODEX.md.

The Saga: a character's most significant entities (NPCs/enemies/factions/places/threads), derived + ranked from the world ledger + gazetteer + faction web by stake × frequency × recency. computeSaga(w,c) reads; refreshSaga(w,c) persists onto c.saga. The dead PC's Saga is what the 14 bardo vision-rolls act on (docs/DEATH-AND-REBIRTH.md, build step 1). Added 2026-06-21.

The death→rebirth loop (docs/DEATH-AND-REBIRTH.md). Step 2: the bardo gap — rollBardoGap() is a 0–49 in-world-day bell roll (triangular, mode ~3–4 weeks); bardoGap(w,[days]) advances the world clock by the gap and turns the faction web once per elapsed week. Step 3: the 14 vision-rolls — bardoVisions(w,c) dreams 7 peaceful + 7 wrathful outcomes over the dead PC's Saga (fireVision mutates faction clocks / NPC + place fate / threads via applyVision, writes the truth to the ledger, surfaces a Fragment to the player; VISION_OUTCOMES is draft flavor pending an authored table). runBardo(w,c) orchestrates refreshSaga→gap→visions, storing c.visions. Step 5: corpse + loot decay — a fallen PC's body+effects persist (set at death); corpseStatus(w,c) decays fresh→disturbed→gone by elapsed in-world days vs the body's CORPSE_CONTEXTS; corpsesAt(w,node) finds recoverable bodies; claimCorpse(w,c,taker) transfers the haul. Layer 2 (query/logic; only L1/L2 deps). Added 2026-06-21.

The world-facing renders (DOM): the world panel, the hex map SVG, the route map, the ledger, the opening, powers, the start screen, and the universe shelf. Creator renders (renderBardo/renderCharge) live with the creator domain. shopPanel (docs/SHOP-UI.md §3) renders the tabbed Buy|Sell merchant panel — reads shopOf/shopAttitude (world.shop) + itemPrice/isConsumable/sellValue (engine.economy) for display only; every transaction routes through world.shop's buyItem/sellItem. combatPanel (docs/COMBAT-TRACKER.md) renders the read-only band-lane fight tracker over GS.combat — foe HP/AC never enter the DOM, only a derived state word (cmFoeStateWord); actionsAbilitiesBody now also fills from CLASS_PROGRESSION + ORIGIN_FEATS (§3).

Track-B compiled-tables dice engine: CT (reads window.GENESIS_TABLES from tables.js), rollExpr (flat/bell/mixed dice strings), rollTable (roll a compiled table by id). Distinct from engine.tables, which rolls the inline-data tables.

Segment walk-roller (docs/SESSION-PREP.md §2). rollUrbanWalk(opts) picks a topology (16 graph-shape pacing grammars), builds the segment graph, rolls each node's segment sub-table (dedup+overflow), encounter, and scene frame from the compiled tables (row[5] cells), and returns the walk as a data structure (segments=nodes, transitions=edges). Ported from the Obsidian 'Urban Procedure v3.1' Templater; no file/canvas output. WALK-REFRESH §2.1: also carries a per-segment loot lane (reuses dwalkBudget/dwalkAssignLoot/dwalkLoot from engine.dungeon-walk verbatim, called at runtime after full load-order — declared in a module that loads AFTER this one, same hoisting pattern the rest of the walk family already relies on; only the presentation frame — stash/lockbox/strongbox — differs). WALK-REFRESH §2.3: walkSpiceBand/walkIsStrangePlus gate a spice-graded chance that a Discovery segment/finale IS a rollItem macguffin. WALK-REFRESH §3: rollWalkSkin(envKind) rolls the compiled walk-skin-<envKind> table (null-safe until tables-wave1 authors it) — called by all three walk-rollers + travel walks (via rollWildernessWalk) at assembly, stored as walk.skin={text,band,ref}.

WALK-REFRESH §1 — live rosters for the walk-rollers. A code-side registry (WALK_ARCHETYPES, keyed by the archetype string as it appears in the tables — wilderness enemy-category names + dungeon/urban threat-identity ids) mapping each to bestiary tag filters (type/sizeMax/habitatPref) + a per-tier/slot CR band. resolveArchetypePool(archetypeName,{tier,biome,slot},authoredPoolStr) unions the registry-filtered BESTIARY pool with the authored 'A / B / C' pool (the floor, kept present at ~35% weight — WALK_ARCHETYPE_FLOOR_WEIGHT) and returns one creature name string, byte-compatible with the old walkPickFromPool(pool) call sites. Unknown archetype or an empty bestiary match falls back to the authored pool only (graceful, today's exact behavior). Adam's 95 custom creatures enter rotation automatically (indexed with CR in data/bestiary.js) — a deliberate feature, not a side effect.

Dungeon walk-roller (docs/SESSION-PREP.md §2). rollDungeonWalk(opts): 12 topologies, depth-budgeted loot, affinity-filtered boss/revelation (by rolled Myth Seed) → dungeon data structure (rooms=nodes, doors=edges). Ported from the Obsidian 'Dungeon Procedure v4.2'. Reuses engine.walk generics. WALK-REFRESH: dwalkOutlandish/dwalkOutlandishAllowed (§2.2, PROVISIONAL null-safe level-gate on the future dungeon-loot-outlandish Band column) + a Strange+ plot-item chance on Discovery rooms (§2.3) + the rolled walk.skin (§3, via rollWalkSkin).

Wilderness leg-walk roller (docs/SESSION-PREP.md §2). rollWildernessWalk(opts): a linear journey of travel legs (biome can shift) + an arrival, each leg an encounter + travel texture → journey data structure (legs=nodes, route=edges). Authored from the wilderness table set (no source generator). Reuses engine.walk generics. WALK-REFRESH §2.1: also carries a per-leg loot lane (wwalkLootLane/wwalkLootFor reuse dwalkBudget/dwalkAssignLoot/dwalkLoot from engine.dungeon-walk verbatim; only the presentation frame — cache/remains/grave-goods — differs). WALK-REFRESH §2.3: a Strange+ plot-item chance on Discovery legs. WALK-REFRESH §3: the rolled walk.skin (null-safe until tables-wave1 lands) — also covers travel walks, since world.play's travel() calls this same roller.

Quest-hook roller (docs/SYNTHESIS-CONTRACT.md). rollQuestHook({environment}) → raw hook material (destination flavor, macguffin, complication, urgency clock, questgiver-avoidance, pitch) bound to a prepped environment; questgiver identity left for the synthesis pass to assign. Reuses engine.walk's walkPick.

Prep-bundle assembler (docs/SYNTHESIS-CONTRACT.md) — the deterministic pre-step of the synthesis pass. assemblePrepBundle({world,tier,environments}) fires the multi-environment walk rollers, binds a quest hook to each, and gathers ledger context from the live world → the input bundle the staged synthesis prompts consume. prepBundleSummary() → the cheap Stage-1 view. No LLM.

The CODEX rollers (Phases 2+5; docs/CODEX.md §2) — the engine mints the atoms. rollNPC()/rollPlace()/rollItem()/rollBuildingInterior()/rollLoot() chain the compiled npc-*/place-*/plot-item/plot-lock/building-interior/dungeon-loot-* tables (via rollTable / the dungeon-walk budget chain) into a codexAdd-ready payload: `rolled` (raw dice verbatim), a player-safe `fields` glance-read, and DM-only `dm` levers; items carry a `source` pointer (§8b). They do NOT write the world — prep/the DM emit codex_add events. The AI assigns final meaning + wires links.

The Critical-Magnitude engine (docs/CRIT-MAGNITUDE.md §1, §4) — a nat 20/1 demands a second d20 (the magnitude die). rollCritMagnitude(natural,{magnitude}) maps the band → a lens count, draws that many DISTINCT lenses from the compiled mythic-success/failure-lenses (d12), and routes the row-1 'a place is transformed/scarred' lens into the Myth suite (rolls myth-seeds). Returns an atom payload only (rolled dice + lens vectors); never writes the world — the DM narrates, then emits a crit_outcome event (world.dm) to canonize a Mythic result to the Ledger.

The Attitude/Parley/Morale RESOLVER (docs/SOCIAL.md §2-§4,§6; SOCIAL Phase 2) — the social analog of combat. PURE + DETERMINISTIC: every fn takes plain numbers/flags and returns a DELTA, never reading/writing the world. socialDC(value) = the DC to shift attitude one step friendlier (Hostile 25 → Friendly 10; Helpful terminal); applyLeverage(dc,levers) folds the NPC Want/Fear/Leverage/Trust-Lever mods (±5) and flags a decisive auto-shift; resolveSocialCheck(input) returns {outcome,from,to,shift,terrified,granted} (one check = one step; caught lie −2, miss-by-5 −1, intimidation overshoot → Terrified); moraleDC(trigger,mods)/resolveMorale(input) drive fight-or-flight (held vs. broke → caller rolls Morale Outcome); insightReadDC(input) = the scaled read-attitude DC (10 +5 guarded + best mental mod if masking). The Phase-3 event layer calls these then commits via codexSetAttitude/codexSetTerrified.

The Consequence-Ladder RESOLVER (docs/CONSEQUENCE-LADDER.md) — turns a spice-graded flavor roll into an optional, player-pulled thread without fractaling. PURE + DETERMINISTIC (mirrors engine.social): never reads/writes the world. consequenceFor({legs,band,pool}) classifies a tagged roll into a descriptor (sink + opensThread + clock + band-intensity) — consequence routes on LEGS, band sets intensity (§3/§4). clResolveEffect(pool,dieTotal) reads the pooled effect die (Hungering-Stone shape: Nature|Use|Tell|Escalation) for the PLAYER's open roll; CL_POOLS is the pluggable archetype→table registry (Watcher built; rest null → graceful degrade to DM/on-the-fly per DM-CHARTER §8.5). clBindFirst(candidates,seed) scores existing threads for reincorporation (bind-first), else null → clOnMissPlan names the roll-on-miss generator. The wiring layer (applyEvent) orchestrates latent → bind-first → roll-on-miss and commits via codex/ledger events.

The theater-of-the-mind 5.5 combat RESOLVER (docs/COMBAT.md). PURE + DETERMINISTIC (mirrors engine.social/engine.consequence): operates only on the passed transient combat objects, never on w/U/codex. THE SCRIPT OWNS THE NUMBERS — creature resolution (resolveCreature: name → BESTIARY → CR-band fallback → quick-stats), side-based initiative (rollInitiative), attack/save/damage math (resolveAttack/resolveSave/cmRollDamage; dice-bearing fns accept a pre-rolled d20 so the player's open roll drives the PC), HP/condition/range-band tracking (applyDamage/moveBand/CM_BANDS), the PC's own weapon damage (cmEquippedDamage: resolves sh.equipped + sh.inventory against data/items.js's ITEMS_BY_NAME instead of a DM-recalled o.dmg — honors the SRD base two-weapon-fighting rule, docs/ITEMS.md), and the PC's AC from worn armor (cmEquippedAC: 5.5e Light/Medium/Heavy + shield; cmSheetAC folds in the flat feat bonus sh.acBonus; defaultEquip picks a sensible starting loadout — docs/ITEMS.md). combatStart builds GS.combat (the caller stashes it); combatFromEncounter wires walk.js encounters → resolved foes; combatOutcomeEvents derives the EVENT-CONTRACT payloads (encounter_resolved + per-foe kill) which world/dm.js applyEvent emits + prices (CR-XP, objective-gated) + escalates (kill{factionId} → clock_advanced). Added 2026-06-30.

Economy v1 (docs/ECONOMY.md) — the buy/sell ENGINE spine. PURE + DETERMINISTIC (mirrors engine.combat/engine.social): computes prices, rolls place-tier-gated shop stock, and validates buy/sell transactions; NEVER narrates and NEVER applies state — every transaction helper returns an `item_changed` event payload for the caller to apply via the existing applyEvent runtime (src/world/dm.js:693), the ONE event that touches gear/coin (no parallel mutator). itemPrice resolves mundane gear off data/items.js's SRD `cost` (itemDef, unit-converted to gp) and magic gear off the RARITY_VALUE band (magicDef + data/economy.js), halved for a detected consumable (isConsumable: name-pattern + magic-catalog category). sellValue applies SELL_RATIO and caps payout to a merchant's remaining coin (the sell-side saturation guard, capped:true). rollShopStock/makeShop/merchantCoin build a shop record gated by PLACE_TIERS (goods tiered by place, never PC level; Very Rare+ never surfaces) and are deterministic under an injectable rng — an apothecary always guarantees a healing-consumable stock line. previewBuy/previewSell validate (stock/price/gold/held-instance/coin-cap) and emit the exact item_changed payload the handler expects; the caller applies it and folds in the returned stockDelta/coinDelta. Inert until a future shop UI/DM open_shop event consumes it — zero edits to render.js/genesis.html beyond this file's own <script> tag. Added 2026-07-01.

The CHECK/SAVE SPINE (docs/SRD-MECHANIZATION.md §1) — the one d20 primitive the whole game routes through. resolveCheck({d20?,abilityMod,proficient,bonus,dc,advantage,reroll}) → {total,natural,success,margin,degree}: unifies the combat-only resolveSave and the half-existing dmRollFor into one pure primitive with the three thin callers resolveSkillCheck/resolveSaveCheck/resolveAbilityCheck (ability from SKILL_ABILITY, proficiency from sh.skillProfs/saveProfs). Owns the COMPUTED DIFFICULTY.md margin ladder (checkDegree: crit-success/success/near-miss[−1..−2 only]/failure/crit-failure — anti-drift, not DM-eyeballed) + the single-source spellSaveDC (8+pb+spellAbility mod, finally resolved against) + Heroic Inspiration (sh.inspiration bool; grant/spend/has — RAW reroll, new result stands). Exhaustion (§5) −2×level folds into every caller via exhaustionBonus. Dice path accepts the player's open d20 (never rolls FOR the player). Added 2026-07-01.

The CONDITIONS engine (docs/SRD-MECHANIZATION.md §3) — a script-owned condition→effect table (CONDITIONS) the resolver consults so the DM stops re-ruling 'blinded' every occurrence. conditionAdvDis(attacker,target) auto-derives attack advantage/disadvantage from both combatants' conditions; conditionAutoFail derives auto-fail Str/Dex saves under paralysis/stun/unconscious; isIncapacitated composes stunned/paralyzed/unconscious (load-bearing for §2 concentration-break + §6 no-actions). addCondition({condition,ttl}) carries a STRUCTURED duration (rounds / untilSave / endOfNextTurn / concentration-linked / indefinite); tickConditions advances counters at turn boundaries and returns expiries (condition_expired). PURE: operates on plain condition-bearing objects (a foe or {conditions:[...]} on the PC), never on w/U. Added 2026-07-01.

CONCENTRATION enforcement (docs/SRD-MECHANIZATION.md §2) — the highest-impact correctness gap. sh.concentration={spell,castRound}|null: startConcentration auto-drops any prior (concentration_broken cause:recast) and sets the new; concentrationSaveDC(dmg)=max(10,floor(dmg/2)); concentrationDamageSave routes the CON save through §1 resolveSaveCheck and breaks on failure/0-HP/incapacitating condition. ritualEligible(name) reads the full spell index's ritual flag. spellIndexByName resolves a spell record from the full SPELLS index (data/spells.js, 339 spells with concentration/ritual/duration/etc). PURE on the passed sheet; the world layer (applyEvent) emits concentration_start/concentration_broken. Added 2026-07-01.

The COMBAT-ACTION layer (docs/SRD-MECHANIZATION.md §6) — the martial half. Action-economy budget {action,bonus,reaction,moved} per combatant (resetTurnBudget at turn start, spendBudget refuses a second Action / used Reaction). standardAction applies real mechanical effect for Dodge/Disengage/Dash/Help/Ready/Hide/Search/Study/Utilize (self-conditions + one-shot flags §1/§3 consume). attacksPerAction(sh) derives Extra Attack from CLASS_PROGRESSION (Fighter/Barbarian/Paladin/Ranger/Monk → 2 at L5; Fighter → 3 at L11). opportunityAttack fires on an undefended Melee-leave (via moveBand), suppressed by Disengage, one reaction/round. resolveGrapple/resolveShove are CONTESTED §1 checks (Athletics vs Athletics-or-Acrobatics, target's choice, tie favors defender) → condition_add. PURE on the passed combatants/sheet. Added 2026-07-01.

MONSTER TACTICS (docs/MONSTER-TACTICS.md) — the script proposes, trash plays itself, morale binds (§0 Adam's forks, LOCKED). PURE + DETERMINISTIC (mirrors engine.combat/engine.social/engine.check): operates only on the passed transient foe/combat objects, never on w/U/GS. §1 proposeTactic: the anti-drift ladder — a creature's own custom d10 table (ctRollCustomTable, rolled verbatim off data/bestiary.js customTables) → the walk archetype's rolled Behavior hook (foe.behavior, normalized at the walk→combat seam in engine.combat combatFromEncounter) → the state-machine fallback (ctStateMachine: bloodied/pack-flank/ambusher-hold/leader-down/ranged-retreat/press). ADVISORY output ({action,targetHint,rationale,source}); combatProposals maps a live combat's foes → their proposals (the digest.combat.proposals[] payload — DM-facing, never player-rendered; the DM-BRIDGE wiring of that digest field is frontier prose, out of scope here). §2 Morale — BINDING: moraleTrigger detects the once-per-fight-per-foe triggers (side-bloodied/leader-down/bloodied-outnumbered/fear-effect); moraleAlreadyFired/markMoraleFired are the caller-owned once memory (GS.combat.moraleFlags); rollMorale is the script-rolled OPEN WIS save vs MORALE_DC (±MORALE_MODS by foe.creatureType — undead/construct auto-pass, beast −2, threaded from BESTIARY's type tag via engine.combat cmFoeFrom) → on a fail, the §2 d6 disposition table (flee/surrender/rout-panic). §3 Trash autoplay: autoplayEligible gates CR≤AUTOPLAY_CR_MAX, no custom table, not the leader, not dm.noAutoplay; resolveFoeTurn composes proposeTactic → the built resolver (resolveAttack) into one open-rolled result the caller turns into ledger lines + hp_changed. Added 2026-07-02.

DEATH SAVES + TEMP HP + massive damage (docs/SRD-MECHANIZATION.md §4). sh.deathSaves={succ,fail}|null (startDeathSaves at 0 HP, cleared on any heal>0 / long rest). resolveDeathSave(d20): 10+ success / nat20 revive+1hp+clear / nat1=2 fails / <10 fail; 3 succ→stable, 3 fail→dead (caller routes to Death & Rebirth). Damage at 0 HP = one auto-fail (two if crit/melee-in-5ft). Temp HP: sh.tempHp separate pool that absorbs damage first, does NOT stack (takes the higher), doesn't heal, lost on long rest — applyDamageWithTemp deducts tempHp before hpCur. isMassiveDamage(remaining,maxHp): remaining≥maxHp after 0 → instant death (skip death saves). PURE on the passed sheet. Added 2026-07-01.

EXHAUSTION + environmental HAZARDS (docs/SRD-MECHANIZATION.md §5). Exhaustion: sh.exhaustion 0–6 (addExhaustion/removeExhaustion; the −2×level d20 penalty lives in engine.check exhaustionBonus, the −5ft×level speed in exhaustionSpeedPenalty; level 6 = death). resolveFall(feet)=floor(feet/10)d6 bludgeoning cap 20d6. hazardTick(kind) → the per-turn damage schedule for on-fire (Burning 1d4, reusing the ITEMS §D elemental pattern) / suffocation / drowning, emitted as hp_changed by the world layer. HAZARDS is the kind→formula registry. PURE (reuses cmRollDamage). Added 2026-07-01.

The dice visual engine — one tumble-then-settle animation (dieRoll) + the spice 'juice' (diceSpice) + the polyhedral board overlay (diceOverlay, docs/DICE-OVERLAY.md) for every die in the game. Context adapters (animateDie/bardoDieFx/bardoFx) delegate here. Generic + DOM-only so all layers call down into it.
The Oracle tab — filter/roll any compiled table, with the spice chip. ORC is the tab's local state.
App chrome: showTab (panel switch + per-tab render dispatch) and toast (transient notice). toast is called by world.state's reveal().
Ability-score logic: 4d6-drop, roll/assign/best, swap + drag-drop, background ASI, and the derived-stat calc (HP/AC/PP/saves). abilMod lives here.
The Life chain (Xanathar-style): table lookups, person descriptions, origins/path/events beats, the headline, and seedFromLife (writes life NPCs/threads to the ledger).
The manual charge-sheet UI (Layer-1 guided sheet): bind/cancel, chips, pick, and renderCharge.
The spirit-guide guided creator flow — the bardo state machine, beat helpers, dice FX, name rolls, and renderBardo. The mutable BARDO state stays app-owned.
Wandering Souls roster (read/bank/remove/render) + the species name generators. Canon souls come from data.souls-canon; this manages the live roster.

The in-app LEVEL-UP CHOICE PICKER (docs/ADVANCEMENT.md). The mechanical recompute lands in applyLevelUp (level_applied); this modal surfaces the interpretive picks the engine can't decide — new cantrips, new spells known, and the ASI at L4/L8 — computing per-level deltas from CLASS_PROGRESSION. Subclass stays DM-narrated in v1. openLevelUp returns false (no modal) for pure-feature levels or headless contexts, so picks gracefully fall back to DM-narrated. Transient state in GS.LEVELUP; applyLevelChoices is the single mutator (writes spells, applies ASIs, ripples HP/AC/PP + pool maxes).

The SESSION SEAM — carry-forward harvest + the session-shape pacing model (docs/CONSEQUENCE-LADDER.md §7.1–§7.2). The session boundary is the promotion tick: endSession calls seamHarvest(w) (open codex handles + interaction-salience + faction/pressure clocks + last shape + ON-DEMAND-GEN §8's sessionProvenance + ADVANCEMENT-RETUNE.md §4's xpReport → w.carryForward) then seamProposeShape(cf) (ranks the next-session SHAPE from honest heuristics — contrast the last shape, pay off salience, fire near clocks, keep it deadly; DM-only, the player never sees it). beginSession calls seamWeave(cf,shape) to classify each open thread trivialize/sustain/escalate, subordinate to the shape. seamHarvest reads w (never mutates); seamProposeShape/seamWeave are PURE on the carry-forward. xpReportOf reads this-session's XP ledger lines + w.xpDecay.lost into {total,bySource,decayLost,paceThisLevel,paceTarget} — the re-tune's ONE tuning instrument (never guesses; zeros not NaN on an XP-less session). The engine owns the decision; the AI executes the texture (bind-first → invent-and-capture) — §8.5 at the seam. v1 heuristics.

THE WORLD TURN (docs/WORLD-TURN.md): worldTurn(w,trigger,ctx) orchestrates T1 (montage, deepens ssFactionTurn with life-event eligibility + faction-outcome-on-fire), T3 (revisit-after-absence — node.lastVisitDay stamping + lazy drift resolution, escalation override, arrivalBrief digest surface). turnFactionOutcome mutates w.factions on a fired agenda clock (advance/setback/splinter/merge/takeover/collapse). turnLifeEvent rolls a known NPC's fate + mints a successor thread on death/vanishing (thread-linked). turnRecall/turnEcho are the reincorporation oracle (§5) — a salience-weighted draw over known/hard codex records, surfaced via the gen loop's kind:"recall" and the digest's sessionLean.echo lull nudge. NULL-SAFE throughout: place-drift/npc-life-event/faction-outcome aren't compiled yet — every rollTable() call degrades to a logged no-op.

World-flow orchestration: the world-genesis ritual (startGenesis/rollStage/rollTriad/bindWorld — bindWorld also casts the start town's ON-DEMAND-GEN §6 ambient pool once), session + exploration loop (beginSession/explore/passTime/enterWorld — passTime is the rest-gate that claims a pending level-up), spawn (rollCharacter), and destroy.

The death entry + bardo passage (REWORKED 2026-06-21, Death & Rebirth step 7): killCharacter stamps the in-world time of death (c.fellWhen) + writes the fall as canon, openBardo runs runBardo (world.rebirth: gap drift + 14 visions) and renderBardoPassage reveals the vision Fragments to the player, closeBardo rolls a brand-new successor. The legacy d20 spawn-back is retired.

The player-facing inventory ACTIONS (docs/ITEMS.md) — equip/unequip a named slot + use a consumable, from the character panel's inline onclick handlers. Thin shells over applyEvent (world/dm.js owns the mutation + ledger); slotForItem picks the slot from the resolved base kind. Added 2026-07-01 (the interactive layer the read-only panel lacked).
DM export — assembles the character + full world/scene handoff text (state, time, location, recent transitions) for the AI DM, with a clipboard fallback.

Session-Prep state (docs/SESSION-PREP.md #3+#5): startPrep assembles the bundle + binds each environment to a SOFT 'rumored frontier' node (soft edge = the quest hook); applyPrep enriches frontiers from the DM's synthesis overlays + writes soft new-canon; lockOnContact flips soft→hard on entry (Charter §8.4); prepHandoff/copyPrepHandoff export the staged bundle for the Bridge. Recycle/debt for unvisited prep. TRAVEL-WALKS (docs/TRAVEL-WALKS.md): prepStartTravelWalk stores a kind:"travel" walk directly on the destination node's prep slot (walkOfFrontier reads pn.walk first); walkAdvance/walkComplete branch on pn.kind==="travel" for per-segment clock + arrival-vs-promotion.
Capture as re-entry: drops a subdued PC into a holding segment of the active walk (WALK-CONSUMPTION §6).

HYBRID FAST-LANE TRIAGE (docs/DM-BRIDGE.md §"Hybrid fast-lane"). dmTriage(w,action,opts) is a PURE, script-owned classifier deciding which model lane the DM loop answers on, so routing is mechanized instead of the DM eyeballing stakes per turn (anti-drift: the script owns the decision). Default FAST; escalate to DEEP only on signals knowable before the DM composes — combat-active/combat-action, first contact with a place (new-place, via w.dm.lastNarratedNodeId), the PC in jeopardy (pc-downed/pc-bloodied/pc-condition), a doom clock come due (clock-due), or death (no-living-pc). Returns {lane,model,reasons[]}; sendTurn stamps lane/laneModel/laneReasons onto the turn. The DM keeps an UPGRADE override for deep beats only it can foresee mid-compose (Mythic crit, major revelation); it never downgrades.

The DM Bridge client + the EVENT-CONTRACT runtime. dmDigest()/sendTurn/pollResponse/applyResponse run the turn→response handshake against dev/dm-bridge.py; applyEvent(w,e) dispatches typed EVENT-CONTRACT.md events to the real mutators (the DM never writes U — item_use fires potion effects, charge_spend/charge_restore manage magic-item charges, item_changed mints the congruent base/ench/codex overlay, open_shop mints/loads a w.shops record per docs/SHOP-UI.md §2b). Dev/test harness per docs/DM-BRIDGE.md; the runtime is reused by ADVANCEMENT/DIFFICULTY.

The shop TRANSACTION layer (docs/SHOP-UI.md §4) — keeps render.js lean. shopOf resolves a w.shops record; shopAttitude resolves the clamped codex-attitude rung ONCE per render/transaction (docs/SHOP-UI.md §3b) so the render path and the transaction path price identically. setShopTab/selectShopRow drive the tabbed confirm-on-plaque UI state (GS.shopTab/GS.shopSel). buyItem/sellItem call previewBuy/previewSell (src/engine/economy.js) then apply the returned item_changed event via the real applyEvent runtime (src/world/dm.js) — the ONE event that touches gear/coin; on success they deplete the shop's stock/coin (applyStockDelta/addToShopStock), saveU, and re-render. Every refusal path toasts (buyRefusalMsg/sellRefusalMsg) — never a silent no-op. Added 2026-07-01.

Entry point — the carve is complete: all logic + flow data now live in src/** and data/**. genesis.html holds the DOM, styles, the <script> load order, and a boot tail (let U=loadU(); migrateAll(); render/showTab). The 'owns *' is now just the app-owned universe handle U + the inline onclick contract that keeps module functions global.
